title: SCA Minhag of the Week 228: "B’Simana Taba Before Reading Perashat Bereshit"

chapters.title: Rabbi Haim Palachi and the Ben Ish Chai
Widespread Sephardic Custom
chapters.about: Keter Shem Tov,Rabbi Moshe Swisa,Morocco and Libya

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the custom of saying the words "Besimana Taba" before reading Parashat Bereshit. He covers the views of various authorities, including Rabbi Haim Palachi and the Ben Ish Chai, regarding whether this practice constitutes an interruption between the blessing and the reading.
questions: Why do we say "Besimana Taba" before reading Parashat Bereshit?
What did Rabbi Haim Palachi write about saying "Besimana Taba"?
How does the Ben Ish Chai defend the custom in Rav Pe'alim?
What was the custom in Jerusalem, Hebron, Morocco, and Libya?
